release_notes: Prerelease from https://github.com/mwongj/VOD2MLIB/pull/2 (source PR remains open). Adds persistent incremental generation decisions in SQLite schema 3. Movie runs compare streamed eligible source/metadata/settings/ownership projections and only hydrate new or changed candidates; unchanged output is authoritative in inventory and avoids per-file filesystem checks. Existing verified inventory seeds decisions without re-reading every STRM. Plugin deletions invalidate decisions; Rebuild / discover inventory handles external additions/edits/removals and resets decisions. TV episode output skips unchanged STRMs while preserving required on-demand provider refreshes. Raw URLs, native category eligibility, bounded batches/queues, complete M3U-removal checks, edited NFO/ownership protection and worker deadlines/cancellation remain intact. Includes generation_cache.py and new candidate timing counters. Validation: 321 plugin tests passed with four Windows skips; publisher/package tests passed. Live supervised movie validation: initial seeding 4.6s, unchanged runs 3.7-3.8s, ten changed movies 3.8s versus approximately 20-21s previously, with exact file and inventory verification. Timings exclude upstream M3U sync and Emby import; full rescans retain M3U census and TV provider costs.
